Description: Starts account registration and email verification; test valid input, duplicate email, validation boundaries, optional invitation token, and email-provider failure. Password must contain at least 12 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes.
Pre-Condition: No account exists for the email. MongoDB is available. Brevo is configured for successful email-delivery cases.

Description: Verifies the email challenge and OTP, activates the account, and returns the signed-in user and tokens; test valid, invalid, expired, exhausted-attempt and invitation-token cases.
Pre-Condition: A valid, unused verification challenge exists. For success, the correct six-digit OTP is available from the test email provider.

Description: Issues a replacement verification code; test resend cooldown, hourly limit, invalid challenge and invitation-token mismatch.
Pre-Condition: A pending verification challenge exists. Brevo is configured for successful delivery.

Description: Authenticates email/password, starts verification for an unverified account, and issues tokens for a verified account; test invalid credentials and inactive accounts.
Pre-Condition: The user account exists. Email verification and organization state are prepared for the selected test case.

Description: Verifies Google credentials and nonce, handles account linking and invitation context, and returns user tokens; test invalid credentials and unverified/inactive accounts.
Pre-Condition: Google client ID is configured. Use a valid test Google credential for success cases.

Description: Validates a refresh token and issues renewed tokens while respecting account status, email verification and invitation context.
Pre-Condition: A valid refresh token exists for success cases. Prepare expired and malformed tokens for negative cases.

Description: Completes onboarding and ensures an eligible personal user has a personal workspace.
Pre-Condition: An authenticated active user has not completed onboarding; prepare personal and organization-member accounts.

Description: Creates an organization for an eligible account and verifies owner/workspace assignment and invalid membership transitions.
Pre-Condition: An authenticated eligible user has no conflicting organization membership. MongoDB transactions are available.

Description: Returns organization details only when the requested organization matches the caller's organization.
Pre-Condition: An authenticated organization member and a second organization fixture exist.

Description: Updates organization name, tax code and address; test validation, trimming, clearing optional fields and authorization.
Pre-Condition: The caller is the Owner (or an allowed Administrator) of the organization. Prepare valid and invalid update payloads.

Description: Deletes an eligible organization and handles pending invitations; test rejection when deletion constraints are not met.
Pre-Condition: The caller is an authorized Owner/Administrator. Prepare organizations with and without contracts or other members.

Description: Creates an invitation for an allowed role and email; test duplicates, capacity limits, unauthorized roles and email-delivery errors.
Pre-Condition: Caller is the organization Owner. Organization capacity is available and email delivery is configured for success cases.

Description: Returns paginated invitations and their states for the specified organization.
Pre-Condition: Caller is the Owner. Prepare pending, accepted, revoked and expired invitation records.

Description: Revokes an eligible invitation and prevents it from being accepted afterward.
Pre-Condition: Caller is the Owner. A pending invitation exists in the caller's organization.

Description: Returns paginated organization members with role and account state; verifies organization isolation.
Pre-Condition: Caller is the Owner. Prepare multiple members and a second organization.

Description: Removes a member, resets their role/workspace membership, updates permission version, and revokes matching pending invitations. Backend API exists; frontend action is not currently wired.
Pre-Condition: Caller is the Owner. Target is a member of the same organization and is not the Owner. Test through the backend API.

Description: Returns safe invitation details for a valid token and rejects invalid, expired or revoked tokens.
Pre-Condition: Prepare invitations for each token state. No login is required for preview.

Description: Accepts an invitation for the matching email, assigns the invited role and rejects users already belonging to an organization or invitations at capacity.
Pre-Condition: Caller is authenticated and has no organization membership. A valid pending invitation and available seat exist for success cases.

Description: Returns the configured plan catalog in price order.
Pre-Condition: Application has initialized the plan records in MongoDB.

Description: Returns current plan, period, scheduled downgrade, usage quotas and member capacity for the caller's organization/workspace.
Pre-Condition: Caller belongs to the requested organization. Prepare personal and business subscription states.

Description: Schedules a lower-priced plan in the same plan family at the effective date; rejects invalid plans and insufficient member capacity.
Pre-Condition: Caller is the organization Owner or personal User. A paid plan is active and a valid lower plan exists.

Description: Cancels an eligible scheduled downgrade and rejects cancellation when the target period has already been paid.
Pre-Condition: Caller is the Owner or personal User. A scheduled downgrade exists.

Description: Creates a contract, validates type/party policy and file format/size, then processes extraction synchronously or asynchronously as requested.
Pre-Condition: Caller has an allowed upload role. Prepare supported and unsupported files; Cloudinary and worker dependencies are configured for full integration cases.

Description: Returns paginated contracts scoped to the caller's organization and applies supported search/filter criteria.
Pre-Condition: Caller has an organization workspace. Prepare contracts with varied statuses and risk levels.

Description: Returns contract details only within the caller's organization and rejects unknown or cross-organization IDs.
Pre-Condition: Caller has an organization workspace. Prepare same-organization and cross-organization contracts.

Description: Returns contract text in original or redacted form with the requested redaction mode.
Pre-Condition: Contract text exists and belongs to the caller's organization. Prepare text containing supported sensitive-data patterns.

Description: Generates a redacted DOCX preview and verifies sensitive values are masked without changing the stored original file.
Pre-Condition: A DOCX contract with detectable sensitive data exists in the caller's organization.

Description: Returns a private, time-limited download link for the contract file and enforces organization access.
Pre-Condition: Contract file is stored in Cloudinary and belongs to the caller's organization.

Description: Deletes an authorized contract and related resources; test role restrictions and missing/cross-organization IDs.
Pre-Condition: Caller has a contract-delete role. Contract and stored-file fixtures exist.

Description: Creates or reuses an idempotent review job, applies role/type policy and reserves usage quota.
Pre-Condition: Caller can review the contract. Contract exists, quota is available, and Redis/worker and Gemini are configured for end-to-end cases.

Description: Returns review history for a contract within the caller's organization.
Pre-Condition: Contract belongs to the caller's organization. Prepare multiple review states.

Description: Returns review status and results only to a caller with access to the related organization and contract.
Pre-Condition: Review exists and belongs to a contract in the caller's organization. Prepare cross-organization and missing IDs.

Description: Streams review progress events and handles completed/failed states and client reconnection.
Pre-Condition: Caller is authenticated and can access the review. A running review is needed for progress-event cases.

Description: Returns extracted clauses for the requested contract and enforces organization isolation.
Pre-Condition: Contract has extracted clauses and belongs to the caller's organization.

Description: Returns risk findings and legal references for the selected contract/review.
Pre-Condition: A completed review with risk findings exists for the caller's organization.

Description: Returns extracted key terms for the selected contract and handles missing results.
Pre-Condition: A contract with completed key-term extraction exists in the caller's organization.

Description: Updates proposed revision text for an authorized finding and validates input and ownership.
Pre-Condition: Caller has a review-capable role. Finding belongs to a contract in the caller's organization.

Description: Removes proposed revision text without deleting the finding or rerunning the AI review.
Pre-Condition: Caller has a review-capable role. Finding belongs to a contract in the caller's organization.

Description: Answers a question using contract context, persists messages and enforces chat quota and idempotency.
Pre-Condition: Caller can review the contract. Contract exists, chat quota is available, and Gemini is configured for integration cases.

Description: Streams the answer, handles interrupted streams and records usage/results consistently.
Pre-Condition: Caller can review the contract. Contract exists, chat quota is available, and Gemini is configured for integration cases.

Description: Returns chat history for the requested contract without exposing another organization's messages.
Pre-Condition: Contract has chat history and belongs to the caller's organization.

Description: Builds and returns a shareable redacted summary for an authorized contract.
Pre-Condition: Contract and review data exist in the caller's organization. Prepare sensitive information to verify redaction.

Description: Returns available contract profiles and supported contract categories.
Pre-Condition: Default profiles have been initialized.

Description: Parses an uploaded legal document and returns a preview before saving; test supported formats, invalid files and expected article counts.
Pre-Condition: Caller is Administrator. Prepare a supported legal file no larger than 20 MB.

Description: Creates a legal source and queues ingestion; verifies validation, accepted response and processing state.
Pre-Condition: Caller is Administrator. Valid preview/metadata and file exist; Redis, worker and Gemini are configured for integration cases.

Description: Returns legal sources available to authenticated users and handles empty or populated datasets.
Pre-Condition: Caller is authenticated. Prepare legal-source records in multiple processing states.

Description: Returns legal-source details and available reference parts; rejects unknown IDs.
Pre-Condition: Legal source exists. Caller is authenticated.

Description: Appends a document part to an existing source and queues ingestion; verifies file and metadata validation.
Pre-Condition: Caller is Administrator. Source exists and a supported legal file is provided.

Description: Resumes eligible legal ingestion and rejects invalid or already-running states.
Pre-Condition: Caller is Administrator. Legal source is in a resumable processing state.

Description: Deletes a legal source and its associated knowledge data, enforcing administrator access.
Pre-Condition: Caller is Administrator. Legal source exists.

Description: Creates a PayOS checkout order for an eligible paid plan. Verify owner-only authorization, server-side price calculation, payment-action and plan-family validation, required idempotency behavior, one-open-order protection, VND/order details, checkout URL and QR persistence, and recoverable handling when provider creation is uncertain. A successful checkout must remain pending and must not grant paid subscription rights before verified settlement.
Pre-Condition: The caller is the Owner of the organization or the owner of an eligible personal workspace. A paid plan and valid purchase action exist. PayOS sandbox credentials are configured. Provide an Idempotency-Key. Prepare no-open-order, existing-same-key, changed-payload, unfinished-order, provider-timeout, and invalid-plan cases.

Description: Returns the authorized owner’s paginated payment history for the requested organization or personal workspace. Verify newest-first ordering, page boundaries, empty results, and that payment records from other workspaces are never exposed.
Pre-Condition: The caller is an authorized subscription owner. Prepare multiple payment orders with different creation dates and statuses, plus an order belonging to another workspace. Test the first page, a later page, and an empty page.

Description: Returns the status and checkout or settlement details for an order owned by the requested workspace. Verify pending, paid, cancelled, expired, failed, and fulfillment-error responses where applicable, and reject unknown or cross-workspace order codes.
Pre-Condition: The caller is an authorized subscription owner. Prepare payment orders in each relevant state, an unknown order code, and an order belonging to another workspace.

Description: Synchronizes a stored order with PayOS and reconciles the authoritative provider status. Verify successful settlement activates the correct plan exactly once, unpaid/cancelled/expired orders grant no rights, mismatched order/link/amount details are rejected, and a missed webhook or failed fulfillment can be recovered safely.
Pre-Condition: The caller is an authorized subscription owner. PayOS sandbox or a deterministic provider mock is configured. Prepare pending, paid, cancelled, expired, partial-payment, mismatched-amount, already-fulfilled, and fulfillment-recovery cases.

Description: Cancels an unpaid PayOS order and reconciles the provider response. Verify paid orders cannot be cancelled through this action, unpaid cancellation releases the open-order restriction, and a payment/cancellation race preserves a confirmed payment and fulfills the subscription correctly.
Pre-Condition: The caller is an authorized subscription owner. Prepare pending unpaid and paid orders, and provider responses for cancellation and payment-race scenarios. PayOS sandbox or a deterministic provider mock is configured.

Description: Verifies the PayOS webhook signature, ignores valid setup probes and unrelated orders, validates currency and payment identifiers, and reconciles the provider order before fulfillment. Verify invalid signatures or mismatched payment data are rejected, duplicate successful notifications are idempotent, and a verified payment activates only the matching plan once.
Pre-Condition: PayOS webhook verification is configured with the sandbox checksum key. Prepare valid and forged/tampered signatures, setup-probe and unrelated-order events, matching and mismatched order data, duplicate notifications, and a valid paid order. The webhook endpoint is reachable for integration tests.
